verses.geez:
ወኮነ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ እምነ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ፡ ዘመንገለ ፡ ኢያሪኮ ፡ እምነ ፡ ጽባሒሁ ፡ ወየዐርግ ፡ እምነ
                  ፡ ኢያሪኮ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ አድባር ፡ ዘውስተ ፡ ገዳም ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤቴል ፡ ሉዛ ።
verses.translation: And the borders of the children of Joseph were from Jordan by Jericho eastward; and they will go up from Jericho to the hill country, to the wilderness, to Bæthel Luza.

translations.lxx: And the borders of the children of Joseph were from Jordan by Jericho eastward; and they will go up from Jericho to the hill country, to the wilderness, to Bæthel Luza.
translations.kjv: And the lot of the children of Joseph fell from Jordan by Jericho, unto the water of Jericho on the east, to the wilderness that goeth up from Jericho throughout mount Bethel,
translations.ron: Apoi au căzut sorţii fiilor lui Iosif; hotarul începe la Iordan, lângă Ierihon, merge către apele Ierihonului, având la răsărit pustiul care se întinde de la Ierihon până la Betel
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγένετο τὰ ὅρια υἱῶν Ἰωσὴφ ἀπὸ τοῦ Ἰορδάνου τοῦ κατὰ Ἱεριχὼ ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν· καὶ ἀναβήσεται ἀπὸ Ἱεριχὼ εἰς τὴν ὀρεινὴν, τὴν ἔρημον, εἰς Βαιθὴλ Λουζά.

verses.geez: ወይወፅእ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤቴል ፡ ወየኀልፍ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ደወለ ፡ ከሮንቲ ።
verses.translation: And they will go out to Bæthel, and will proceed to the borders of Achatarothi.

translations.lxx: And they will go out to Bæthel, and will proceed to the borders of Achatarothi.
translations.kjv: And goeth out from Bethel to Luz, and passeth along unto the borders of Archi to Ataroth,
translations.ron: Şi graniţa merge spre Luz, trece hotarul Archienilor până la Atarot,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξελεύσεται εἰς Βαιθὴλ, καὶ παρελεύσεται ἐπὶ τὰ ὅρια τοῦ Ἀχαταρωθί.

verses.geez:
ወየኀልፍ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ሰብዐቱ ፡ አፍላግ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ለቤቶሮን ፡ ዘታሕትየ ፡ ወይከውን ፡ ሞጻእቶሙ
                  ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ባሕር ።
verses.translation: And they will go across to the sea to the borders of Aptalim, as far as the borders of Bæthoron the lower, and the going forth of them shall be to the sea.

translations.lxx: And they will go across to the sea to the borders of Aptalim, as far as the borders of Bæthoron the lower, and the going forth of them shall be to the sea.
translations.kjv: And goeth down westward to the coast of Japhleti, unto the coast of Bethhoron the nether, and to Gezer; and the goings out thereof are at the sea.
translations.ron: Apoi se lasă spre mare, către hotarele lui Iaflet, până la hotarele Bet-Horonului de jos şi până la Ghezer şi se înfundă la mare.
translations.grk: Καὶ διελεύσεται ἐπὶ τὴν θάλασσαν ἐπὶ τὰ ὅρια Ἀπταλὶμ ἕως τῶν ὁρίων Βαιθωρὼν τὴν κάτω, καὶ ἔσται ἡ διέξοδος αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τὴν θάλασσαν.

verses.translation: And the sons of Joseph, Ephraim and Manasse, took their inheritance.

translations.lxx: And the sons of Joseph, Ephraim and Manasse, took their inheritance.
translations.kjv: So the children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.
translations.ron: Această parte au primit-o fiii. lui Iosif: Manase şi Efraim.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκληρονόμησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἱωσὴφ, Ἐφραῒμ καὶ Μανασσή.

verses.geez:
ወኮነ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ለኤፍሬምኒ ፡ በበ ፡ ሕዘቢሆሙ ፡ ወኮነ ፡ ደወለ ፡ ርስቶሙ ፡ እምነ ፡ ጽባሒሃ ፡ ለአጣሮት ፡ ወኤሮኅ
                  ፡ ወቤቶሮን ፡ እንተ ፡ ላዕሉ ፡ ወጋዛራ ።
verses.translation: And the borders of the children of Ephraim were according to their families, and the borders of their inheritance were eastward to Ataroth, and Eroc as far as Bæthoron the upper, and Gazara.

translations.lxx: And the borders of the children of Ephraim were according to their families, and the borders of their inheritance were eastward to Ataroth, and Eroc as far as Bæthoron the upper, and Gazara.
translations.kjv: And the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families was thus: even the border of their inheritance on the east side was Atarothaddar, unto Bethhoron the upper;
translations.ron: Hotarele fiilor lui Efraim, după familiile lor, au fost acestea: hotarul moştenirii lor era la răsărit Atarot-Adar până la Bet-Horonul de Sus şi Ghezer;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγενήθη ὅρια υἱῶν Ἐφραῒμ κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν· καὶ ἐγενήθη τὰ ὅρια τῆς κληρονομίας αὐτῶν ἀπʼ ἀνατολῶν Ἀταρὼθ, καὶ Ἐρὼκ ἕως Βαιθωρὼν τὴν ἄνω, καὶ Γαζαρά.

verses.geez:
ወየኀልፍ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ባሕር ፡ እምነ ፡ መስዓ ፡ ለቴርማ ፡ ወየኀልፍ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ጽባሕ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ቴናታ ፡
                  ወውስተ ፡ ኤላስ ፡ ወየኅልፍ ፡ እምነ ፡ ጽባሕ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኢያኖከ ።
verses.translation: And the borders will proceed to the sea to Icasmon north of Therma; they will go round eastward to Thenasa, and Selles, and will pass on eastward to Janoca,

translations.lxx: And the borders will proceed to the sea to Icasmon north of Therma; they will go round eastward to Thenasa, and Selles, and will pass on eastward to Janoca,
translations.kjv: And the border went out toward the sea to Michmethah on the north side; and the border went about eastward unto Taanathshiloh, and passed by it on the east to Janohah;
translations.ron: Apoi înainta spre apus pe la miazănoapte de Micmetat, se întorcea la răsărit spre Taanat-Şilo şi trecea pe la răsărit de Ianoah.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλεύσεται τὰ ὅρια ἐπὶ τὴν θάλασσαν εἰς Ἰκασμὼν ἀπὸ Βοῤῥᾶ Θερμᾶ· περιελεύσεται ἐπʼ ἀνατολὰς εἰς Θηνασὰ, καὶ Σέλλης, καὶ παρελεύσεται ἀπʼ ἀνατολῶν εἰς Ἰανῶκὰ,

verses.geez: ወውስተ ፡ መራኮ ፡ ወአጣሮት ፡ ወአዕጻዳቲሆን ፡ ወይበውእ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ኢያሪኮ ፡ ወይወፅእ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ።
verses.translation: and to Macho, and Ataroth, and these are their villages; and they will come to Jericho, and will issue at Jordan.

translations.lxx: and to Macho, and Ataroth, and these are their villages; and they will come to Jericho, and will issue at Jordan.
translations.kjv: And it went down from Janohah to Ataroth, and to Naarath, and came to Jericho, and went out at Jordan.
translations.ron: De la Ianoah se pogora la Atarot şi la Naarata, atingând Ierihonul şi se prelungea până la Iordan.
translations.grk: καὶ εἰς Μαχὼ, καὶ Ἀταρὼθ, καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν· καὶ ἐλεύσεται ἐπὶ Ἱεριχὼ, καὶ διεκβαλεῖ ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰορδάνην.

verses.geez:
ወእምነ ፡ [ጣ]ፉ ፡ የሐውር ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ዲበ ፡ ኬልቃና ፡ ወይከውን ፡ ሞጻእቶሙ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ባሕር ፡
                  ወዝንቱ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ርስቶሙ ፡ ለሕዝበ ፡ ኤፍሬም ፡ በበ ፡ ሕዘቢሆሙ ።
verses.translation: And the borders will proceed from Tapho to the sea to Chelcana; and their termination will be at the sea; this is the inheritance of the tribe of Ephraim according to their families.

translations.lxx: And the borders will proceed from Tapho to the sea to Chelcana; and their termination will be at the sea; this is the inheritance of the tribe of Ephraim according to their families.
translations.kjv: The border went out from Tappuah westward unto the river Kanah; and the goings out thereof were at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim by their families.
translations.ron: De la Tapuah mergea spre apus, către râuleţul Cana, pentru a se sfârşi la mare. Aceasta este partea fiilor lui Efraim, după familiile lor.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπὸ Τάφου πορεύσεται τὰ ὅρια ἐπὶ θάλασσαν ἐπὶ Χελκανα· καὶ ἔσται ἡ διέξοδος αὐτῶν ἐπὶ θάλασσαν· αὕτη ἡ κληρονομία φυλῆς Ἐφραῒμ κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν.

verses.geez:
ወአህጉርኒ ፡ እለ ፡ ፈለጡ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ኤፍሬም ፡ በውስተ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ ርስቶሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ መናሴ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ አህጉሪሆሙ
                  ፡ ወአዕጻዳቲሆሙ ።
verses.translation: And the cities separated to the sons of Ephraim were in the midst of the inheritance of the sons of Manasse, all the cities and their villages.

translations.lxx: And the cities separated to the sons of Ephraim were in the midst of the inheritance of the sons of Manasse, all the cities and their villages.
translations.kjv: And the separate cities for the children of Ephraim were among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.
translations.ron: Şi fiilor lui Efraim li s-au mai dat cetăţi şi în partea fiilor lui Manase; toate acele cetăţi erau cu satele lor.
translations.grk: Καὶ αἱ πόλεις αἱ ἀφορισθεῖσαι τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἐφραῒμ ἀναμέσον τῆς κληρονομίας νἱῶν Μανασσή, πᾶσαι αἱ πόλεις καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν.

verses.geez:
ወኢያጥፍኦሙ ፡ ኤፍሬም ፡ ለከናኔዎን ፡ እለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጋዜር ፡ ወነበሩ ፡ ከናኔዎን ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኤፍሬም ፡
                  እስከ ፡ ዮም ፡ እስከ ፡ አመ ፡ ዐርገ ፡ ፈርዖን ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ወነሥኣ ፡ ወአውዐያ ፡ በእሳት ፡ ወለከናኔዎን ፡
                  ወለፌሬዜዎን ፡ ወለእለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጋዜር ፡ ወግእዎሙ ፡ ወወሀባ ፡ ፈርዖን ፡ ለወለቱ ፡ ሕፄሃ ፡ ኪያሃ ።
verses.translation: And Ephraim did not destroy the Chananite who dwelt in Gazer; and the Chananite dwelt in Ephraim until this day, until Pharao the king of Egypt went up and took it, and burnt it with fire; and the Chananites, and Pherezites, and the dwellers in Gaza they destroyed, and Pharao gave them for a dowry to his daughter.

translations.lxx: And Ephraim did not destroy the Chananite who dwelt in Gazer; and the Chananite dwelt in Ephraim until this day, until Pharao the king of Egypt went up and took it, and burnt it with fire; and the Chananites, and Pherezites, and the dwellers in Gaza they destroyed, and Pharao gave them for a dowry to his daughter.
translations.kjv: And they drave not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer: but the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites unto this day, and serve under tribute.
translations.ron: Dar Efraimiţii n-au alungat pe Canaanei, care locuiau în Ghezer; de aceea Canaaneii au trăit între Efraimiţi până în ziua de astăzi, plătindu-le bir. În cele din urmă a venit Faraon, regele Egiptului, şi a luat cetatea şi a ars-o cu foc, şi pe Canaanei şi pe Ferezei şi pe locuitorii Ghezerului i-a ucis şi a dat Faraon cetatea de zestre fiicei sale.
translations.grk: Καὶ οὐκ ἀπώλεσεν Ἐφραῒμ τὸν Χαναναῖον τὸν κατοικοῦντα ἐν Γάζέρ· καὶ κατῴκει ὁ Χαναναῖος ἐν τῷ Ἐφραῒμ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταυτης, ἕως ἀνέβη Φαραὼ βασιλεὺς Αἰγύπτου, καὶ ἔλαβεν αὐτὴν, καὶ ἐνέπρησεν αὐτὴν ἐν πυρί· καὶ τοὺς Χαναναίους, καὶ τοὺς Φερεζαίους, καὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐν Γαζὲρ, ἐξεκέντησαν· καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὴν Φαραὼ ἐν φερνῇ τῇ θυγατρὶ αὐτοῦ.
